description: This file provides validation utilities for form fields, including functions for required fields, email validation, minimum length checks, field matching, composition of validators, and schema-based validation for multi-step forms.

methods.name: required(message = "This field is required")
methods.description: Checks if a value is empty (null, undefined, empty string after trim) and returns an error message if so.

methods.name: email(message = "Please enter a valid email address")
methods.description: Validates a simple email format using a regular expression.

methods.name: minLength(len, message)
methods.description: Ensures a string has at least a specified number of characters.

methods.name: matchesField(fieldName, message = "Values do not match")
methods.description: Checks if the value matches another specified field in the data object.

methods.name: compose(...validators)
methods.description: Combines multiple validators into one, returning the first error encountered.

methods.name: validateFields(values = {}, schema = {})
methods.description: Runs validation functions on each field based on a schema and returns an object indicating validity and errors.

methods.name: makeStepValidator(schema = {})
methods.description: Generates a validator specific to a form step, compatible with useWizard, based on a schema.

ctags.name: email
ctags.pattern: /^export function email(message = "Please enter a valid email address") {$/

ctags.name: matchesField
ctags.pattern: /^export function matchesField(fieldName, message = "Values do not match") {$/
